questions.text: A student must classify a lesson on Sanskrit grammar and rule-based word formation. Which syllabus area is the closest match?
questions.rationale: Language sciences include grammar and Sanskrit's linguistic role.

questions.text: A lesson compares how language sounds are articulated and how words are grammatically formed. Which pairing is accurate?
questions.rationale: Shiksha is phonetics; Vyakarana is grammar.

questions.text: A calendar project studies the astronomical basis of traditional timekeeping. Which topic should be consulted first?
questions.rationale: Vedanga Jyotish is the course topic tied to time and calendars.

questions.text: A researcher is investigating historical irrigation systems in Gujarat. Which BKS unit most directly covers the topic?

options.label: C
options.text: Engineering, Technology and Architecture in Ancient Bharat

options.label: D
options.text: Concepts of Life in Ancient Bharat

questions.rationale: Water management, including Gujarat, appears in the engineering/technology unit.

questions.text: A reading assignment asks students to distinguish Puranas from Itihasa as sources of knowledge. Which comparison best matches the syllabus?

options.label: A
options.text: Puranas are described as encyclopaedic works; Itihasa is framed as a source of wisdom

options.label: B
options.text: Puranas refer only to measurements and Itihasa only to grammar

questions.rationale: The syllabus characterizes the two traditions in these respective ways.

questions.text: Which pairing best classifies a lesson on units of time, distance and weight?

options.label: C
options.text: Number system and units of measurement

questions.rationale: Those units are explicitly listed under measurement.

questions.text: A project studies traditional water storage and rainfall collection. Which two syllabus ideas are closest?

options.label: D
options.text: Irrigation and water management; rainwater harvesting

questions.rationale: Both topics are named in the water-management section.

questions.text: A student is asked to explain how a text handles ethical living, duty and liberation. Which framework is most relevant?
questions.rationale: The life-concepts unit covers Purusharthas, ethical life and Moksha.

questions.text: A course discussion separates a student's learning stage from household responsibilities. Which sequence expresses the traditional transition?
questions.rationale: The conventional sequence begins with Brahmacharya and then Grihastha.

questions.text: An assignment studies iron production, textile dyeing and irrigation as evidence of technical knowledge. Which overall unit is appropriate?

options.label: A
options.text: Engineering, Technology and Architecture in Ancient Bharat

questions.rationale: The technologies are grouped in the engineering/technology unit.
